audit.why: Packet and content agree row-by-row; content whys[5]/[6] already argue the Vex edge at first item and late (burst beats stacks, R angles beat the cage) with kit grounding.

audit.whatIsWrong: Trade prose was the dash-fear template against a champion with zero dashes; the decisive Vex-specific interaction — her R recast is a dash, and Event Horizon's edge stuns anything passing through, so R-dashing over the wall is a self-stun — was absent; cooldowns field had no digits (E 20/18.5/17/15.5/14, R 120/90/60, Q 6-4s).
audit.why: Riot text: E 'creates a cage that Stuns enemies that pass through'; Vex R 'recast to dash to them'. Range mismatch 1200 vs 1000 on the Qs grounds the poke plan.
audit.corrected: R-over-the-wall warning now anchors tradeBad, loading and phases[6]; real cooldowns and the stack-denial economy added throughout.

edits.before: His combo is a sprint through your fear field — mark the approach and his engage spell arrives pre-interrupted.
edits.after: He has no dash and no escape — the lane is one rule long: never eat Event Horizon, and his combo never starts.

edits.before: Pre-interrupt the engage with fear geometry and execute the budget shortfall with R. Shorthand: Event Horizon (Cage) down, wave right, go.
edits.after: Poke his stacks off from 1200 range and all-in whenever the cage sleeps. Shorthand: Event Horizon (Cage) down (20s), wave right, go.

edits.before: Veigar wins by landing Event Horizon (Cage), denying your pattern, and out-ranging your plan one polite trade at a time.
edits.after: Veigar wins by caging your dash or your feet, dropping Dark Matter on the stun, and one-shotting the rest with Primordial Burst.

edits.before: E-mark the contact, Q through the marked line for the fear, auto, walk — every trade he answers with a dash just schedules the next fear.
edits.after: Q his last-hit walk-ups — your 1200-range bolt outranges his 1000-range Q, and every Baleful Strike you deny is AP he never gets to bank.

edits.before: Spending the W pulse on poke spacing and then eating the real engage unfeared — the pulse is the matchup against everything that moves fast.
edits.after: R-dashing over the cage wall — the edge stuns your recast mid-flight and converts your execute into his Dark Matter into R one-shot.

edits.before: Ahead, gloom harder: zone Veigar with marked-rotation threat, R every skirmish his team starts, and reset through the kills — fed Vex makes mobility a typo.
edits.after: Ahead, gloom harder: zone Veigar off every last hit — each denied Q is permanent AP he never banks — and R the skirmishes his cage can't reach.

edits.before: - Vex vs Veigar - Track: Veigar Event Horizon (Cage). - Mark before you trade — unmarked rotations are half rotations. - No commits into Event Horizon (Cage). - The ultimate closes arguments; it doesn’t open them.
edits.after: - Vex vs Veigar - Track: Veigar Event Horizon (Cage). - Never R-dash across the cage wall — the edge stuns dashes. - No commits into Event Horizon (Cage). - The ultimate closes arguments; it doesn't open them.

edits.before: Mark and bolt — your trades are honest and your passive makes his mobility dishonest. Bank Gloom procs like currency.
edits.after: Out-range his 1000-range Q with your 1200 bolt — punish every last-hit walk-up and his stack economy starves.

edits.before: Luden's onward, hunt the skirmishes: R into river fights, fear the convergence, and reset off whatever dies. Your range is wherever the missile reaches.
edits.after: Luden's onward, force the cage question: Event Horizon is 20s at rank 1 — bait it with an E feint, then R-E the immobile mage who owns no second answer.

edits.before: - Veigar Event Horizon (Cage): matchup-defining — Only the cage EDGE stuns — hold position near the center or leave before it forms; never dash into the wall. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your W Personal Space like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Event Horizon is 20s at rank 1, 14s at max — only the cage EDGE stuns; hold near the center or leave before it forms, and never dash into the wall. - Primordial Burst is 120s and scales with your missing health — recall before half HP while it's up. - Guard your W Personal Space like a fifth summoner spell.
